title: Chapter 587 - 587 Unfortunately, There Are No Ifs!
content:
Chapter 587 - 587 Unfortunately, There Are No Ifs!

Chapter 587 - 587 Unfortunately, There Are No Ifs!

587 Unfortunately, There Are No Ifs!

Yuan Yuan relied on her influence and quickly attracted the attention of many people.

Some people who were originally happy because they had increased their lifespan by ten years began to feel worried again. Many people joined in the discussion.

Don’t Forget, Don’t Forget: [That’s right. It’s better to master such technique on your own.]

Farewell: [Sigh, he’s still too young.]

…

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to the comments of the people in the real world.

He immediately placed his attention on the ancient chest beside him and casually opened it.

[100 points of spiritual energy. Do you want to use them?]

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—1,000 points of spiritual energy.]

Instantly, Lin Fan’s mind became relaxed and clear.

Then, everything that had happened a long time ago echoed in his mind like a movie. It was clear.

This was a special experience that he had never experienced before.

Lin Fan muttered in his heart, ‘Is this the feeling of having an increase in your spiritual energy? It feels pretty good.

After a while, Lin Fan slowly raised his head and looked at the Heavenly Hound beside him. He realized that it was staring at the orb in the box without blinking. Its entire face was filled with desire.

Lin Fan could not help but laugh, “If you want this spiritual energy, then go and touch it.”

After all, the reason why Lin Fan was able to obtain 1,000 points of spiritual energy was also because of the Heavenly Hound.

In addition, the bond he had established with the Heavenly Hound was also considered a friendship.

Friends should share things with each other.

After hearing Lin Fan’s words, the Heavenly Hound did not hesitate anymore. It stretched out its paw and touched the light orb.

The Heavenly Hound’s pupils flashed slightly, becoming even brighter.

…

The night gradually deepened.

As usual, Lin Fan used his skill—Draw a Circle For Home.

Then, he took out his sleeping bag and fell asleep.

Two days ago, when it was sleeping, the Heavenly Hound would choose to put some distance between itself and Lin Fan.

Humans were afraid of beasts when they slept.

When beasts slept, how could they not be afraid of humans?

However, today, the Heavenly Hound lay quietly beside Lin Fan.

Both of them were sleeping in the forest. It was very quiet and peaceful, forming an extremely warm picture.

At the same time, it also became the new screensaver picture for the viewers.

…

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

As usual, Lin Fan put the sleeping bag into his internal space and started his aimless journey with the Heavenly Hound.

When he arrived near a small hill, a crisp voice rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve been in the Otherworld for 144 hours. You’ve received 200 points of spiritual energy.]

Lin Fan felt a cool sensation in his head, and his entire body felt even more comfortable and relaxed.

At this moment, a rustling sound suddenly came from the surrounding hills.

The sound was very soft. If it were someone else, they probably would not have heard anything.

Lin Fan was not an ordinary person, though.

However, he was very calm, as if he had not heard anything.

In contrast to Lin Fan’s calmness, the Heavenly Hound beside him was starting to feel uneasy.

Its head kept looking around, and it kept turning in circles.

The next moment, a black ant the size of a mouse emerged from the hill.

Then, two, three…

In the end, countless black ants crawled out of the hill.

Hill?

No!

As the black ants crawled out, the hill collapsed and turned into dust.

Wherever the black ants passed, the trees, grass, and rocks all disappeared like bubbles.

The dense black ants circled around Lin Fan and the Heavenly Hound in a fan shape.

They kept moving their mouths and antennae. Looking from afar, it made one’s scalp tingle.

Seeing this…

The Heavenly Hound grew more and more anxious. It kept circling around as if it wanted to leave.

However, when it saw Lin Fan, who had not moved at all, it stopped in its tracks.

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

“So many scary ants!” Xiao Bing exclaimed.

Late: [Are these ants?!]

People Of the World: [In terms of appearance, they’re indeed ants. They’re just bigger. Oh right, I’m a biology professor.]

Who Are You: [F*ck! These giant ants are so scary.]

Wind: [Moreover, they easily gnawed on trees and rocks. They’re simply super man-eating ants! God Lin, leave quickly!]

Qingchun: God Lin, hurry up and leave!]

Heaven: [Escape!!!]

…

Everyone knew that Lin Fan was extremely powerful.

He could even kill giant pythons and crocodiles with a single strike!

However, the problem was that there were too many ants in front. They were too terrifying.

No one could guarantee that he would be able to kill all of them.

Even the level-six Heavenly Hound was feeling uneasy!

…

When Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Qin Yuxuan, Hu Tian, and the others saw this scene, their breathing stopped slightly.

They all became extremely nervous.

It was as if they were surrounded by countless ants together with Lin Fan.

…

Naturally, Lin Fan did not know the reaction of the people in the real world.

He remained standing calmly on the spot, not moving at all.

Suddenly, the group of ants moved.

They were like sharp arrows that shot toward Lin Fan and the Heavenly Hound.

The Heavenly Hound’s eyes narrowed. It opened its mouth and spat out a fireball.

Smoke filled the air, and the ants were quickly reduced to ashes.

Perhaps the flames had a deterrent effect, but for a moment, no ants dared to continue forward.

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Qing Pingle: [These ants seem afraid of fire.]

Mixed Power: The Heavenly Hound can breathe fire. That’s great. God Lin is saved.]

Hope: [Ants fear fire!]

Celebration: [Heavenly Hound, continue to breathe fire!]

…

When Yuan Yuan saw that Lin Fan was surrounded by the ants, a smile appeared on his face.

Good!

That was great!

Lin Fan was finally in trouble.

If he died, Hua Nation would suffer a terrible punishment.

Sure enough, her decision to become a citizen of Nashland was the right one.

However, before Yuan Yuan could celebrate for long, the Heavenly Hound suddenly shot out flames to stop the ants.

This made Yuan Yuan a little annoyed.

In her heart, she shouted, ‘Ants, don’t be afraid! Hurry up and charge!’

Unfortunately, the ants would not listen to her.

Yuan Yuan looked at the bullet comments in the live broadcast room, and her expression changed. Her hands quickly jumped on the keyboard as she made use of the time to make another Weibo post.

Yuan Yuan: [Unfortunately, there are no ifs!

[If Lin Fan wasn’t proud and complacent, then the person with the ability to control fire now would be Lin Fan himself!

[Lin Fan could then use his fire control ability to resolve this crisis and help Hua Nation survive the apocalypse.

[Now, he could only place his hopes on a dog.

[Unfortunately, there are no ifs!]
